name: fork-ui-human-checks
brief: Close the five 'Human check not made at Gate 3' rows in .sir/backlog.md left by the two fork sessions (Fork glyph shape and size; dimmed, not-allowed Fork control with reason tooltip on no-session and running Pods; 'Forked from <parent>' tab tooltip; fork-error dismiss button layout and contrast; dismiss focus ring, Enter-to-close, and focus landing on the Pods chrome). T1 adds a one-per-session Playwright _electron driver, run-fork-ui.mjs, to the existing hand-run harness. It reuses sandbox.mjs, reaches all four Pod states without a live claude (a direct row write plus a transcript fixture for a real SDK fork, a UUID without a transcript for a failed one, and push:podStatus for running), measures 16 observations with an in-window positive control on each, and records verdicts in FINDINGS-FORK-UI.md. T2 fixes any defect inside the Pods renderer files with a regression test, or escalates it. T3 re-runs the unchanged driver over any fix and runs the repo-wide typecheck and suite. At Gate 3 a backlog row is removed only when every observation mapped to it passed.
